newsitem.title: USA: Index sets reverse split, name change.
newsitem.headline: Index sets reverse split, name change.

text.p: Index Inc, an industrial supplies distributor, said Monday its shareholders have approved a two-for-one reverse split of the company's common shares.

The stock split will become effective on May 13 and every two common shares will be converted into one new common share, it said. Owners of fractional shares will receive cash in lieu of any fraction of a whole share of new stock, it said.

"The reverse stock split is designed to increase the post-split share price of common stock to a level that may be more attractive to investors and to meet listing criteria for the Nasdaq SmallCap Market, said David Little, president and chief executive of the company.
The company also said shareholders approved a change in the company's name to DXP Enterprises Inc.
